title: Knotted Crumbly Uruguayan Cheese Empanadas
description: A traditional Uruguayan dish featuring fermented cheese and fines herbes, perfect for a midnight craving. This low-carb friendly recipe uses a bamboo steamer for cooking.
instructions: Preheat the bamboo steamer to 200 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the queso fresco, fines herbes, egg, almond flour, salt, and black pepper.
Divide the mixture into 8 equal parts and shape each part into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of melted butter in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the butter to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal.
Use a knife to create a knotted pattern on the edge of each empanada.
Place the empanadas in the bamboo steamer and cook for 10 minutes.
